links.outcome: Rate of LLMs abandoning correct treatment recommendations when challenged by personas
links.effect: 7.1% of responses overall were sycophantic. Rates varied tenfold across personas (1.7 to 19.3%) and sixfold across LLMs (2.4 to 15.3%). Vulnerable personas elicited more sycophancy.
links.quote: Overall, 7.1% of responses were sycophantic, varying tenfold across personas (1.7 to 19.3%) and sixfold across LLMs (2.4 to 15.3%).

unlisted_practices: Persona-driven sycophancy evaluation integrated into pre-deployment safety assessment of clinical LLMs

screen.reason: Evaluates sycophantic behavior of frontier LLMs when challenged by different user personas across clinical vignettes, measuring safety risks for patient health queries but not testing a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
